title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£30,000-40,000

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Robert Half are delighted to be partnering with an established and highly regarded business based in Cambourne, Cambridge, to recruit a Credit Controller to join their finance team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller who enjoys taking ownership of their ledger, building strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders, and playing a key role in improving cash collection and reducing outstanding debt.

Reporting into the Credit Control Manager, you will take responsibility for a designated portfolio of customers, working closely with operational teams across the business to ensure debts are managed effectively and queries are resolved promptly. The role offers a varied workload within a supportive and collaborative finance environment.

Responsibilities

As the Credit Controller, you will be responsible for:
- Managing and monitoring the collection of outstanding customer balances
- Working towards monthly cash collection targets
- Building effective relationships with customers and internal stakeholders
- Preparing and distributing aged debt reports
- Issuing customer statements and collection correspondence
- Managing accounts that require credit restrictions or "on stop" procedures
- Investigating and resolving queries that may be delaying payment
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date customer account records
- Processing daily cash receipts, allocations and monthly direct debit payments
- Supporting the setup of new customer accounts
- Supporting the Credit Control Manager with projects aimed at improving cash collection and overall credit control processes

Your Profile

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous experience working within Credit Control
- A proven track record of successfully collecting debt and delivering against targets
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy workload
- Good knowledge of Excel
- Previous experience using ERP/accounting systems, with IFS experience advantageous
- A proactive, professional and positive approach
- The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider team
- A full UK driving licence

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £30 - £32,000
- Hybrid working (Three days in the office and two from home)
- Opportunity to join an established business
- Varied Credit Control position, with plenty of interaction across the wider organisation.
- Occasional travel to other locations across the UK.

For further information or to apply, please contact Robert Half.

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
Talent Acquisition Coordinator - Peterborough - Law Firm
Full Time Permanent Office Based

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Talent Acquisition Coordinator to join the HR team of a successful and growing law firm in Peterborough.

This is a hands-on recruitment role where you will support recruitment activity across the firm, working closely with hiring managers, candidates and external recruitment agencies to ensure vacancies progress efficiently from initial approval through to appointment and onboarding.

The position would suit someone with experience in internal recruitment, talent acquisition or a recruitment agency environment who enjoys managing multiple vacancies and delivering an excellent candidate and hiring manager experience.

The Role

As Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you will support the full recruitment lifecycle, including vacancy management, candidate attraction and sourcing, interview coordination, selection, pre-employment checks and onboarding.

You will work closely with hiring managers and the wider HR team, ensuring recruitment processes remain organised, consistent and efficient.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating recruitment campaigns and vacancies across the firm from approval through to appointment
- Working closely with hiring managers to understand recruitment requirements and keep vacancies progressing
- Drafting engaging and effective job advertisements and recruitment materials
- Proactively sourcing candidates through LinkedIn, job boards and other recruitment channels
- Managing communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process
- Liaising with external recruitment agencies and managing agency engagement
- Coordinating interviews, assessments and selection processes
- Providing practical recruitment guidance and support to hiring managers
- Coordinating pre-employment checks and recruitment documentation
- Supporting the onboarding process for successful candidates
- Maintaining accurate recruitment records and candidate information
- Providing updates and recruitment data to the wider HR team
- Identifying opportunities to improve recruitment processes, systems and candidate experience
- Supporting employer branding and wider candidate attraction initiatives

About You

You will ideally have previous experience working within internal recruitment, talent acquisition or a recruitment agency, with the confidence to manage several vacancies simultaneously.

You should be able to demonstrate:
- Experience managing recruitment campaigns and vacancies
- Candidate sourcing experience across multiple recruitment channels
- Experience using LinkedIn and job boards to identify potential candidates
- Experience supporting and advising hiring managers
- Strong organisational and prioritisation skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- A proactive and practical approach to recruitment
- Confidence building relationships with candidates, hiring managers and recruitment agencies
- Strong attention to detail
- The ability to maintain accurate recruitment records and data

Previous experience within a law firm, professional services, financial services or another regulated environment would be advantageous but is not essential.

Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), recruitment technology or recruitment analytics would also be beneficial.

What's on Offer?

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established professional services organisation that places genuine emphasis on employee development and creating a positive working environment.

Benefits include:
- 25 days' annual leave plus UK Bank Holidays
- Additional day off for your birthday
- Additional annual leave over the Christmas period
- Private healthcare options
- Healthcare cashback plan for you and your family
- Enhanced pension with 5% employer-matched contribution
- Option to purchase up to three additional days' holiday each year
- Group Life Assurance at four times annual salary
- Ongoing professional and personal development opportunities

If you are an experienced Recruitment Coordinator, Talent Acquisition Coordinator, Internal Recruiter, Recruitment Consultant or Talent Acquisition professional looking to move into an in-house recruitment position within the legal/professional services sector, this could be an excellent next step.

Apply with an up-to-date CV for further information and a confidential discussion.

Purchasing Assistant

Are you looking to build a career in purchasing and procurement?

We are working with a well-established organisation that is looking to appoint a Junior Purchasing professional to join its procurement team.
